zh: 把选出的主按容量降序排列，第 j 个主以及它前面的每个主都需要一台不小于自己、互不相同的备，所以第 j 大的主不可能超过全部容量降序排列后的第 2j 项。
把容量降序后相邻两两配对，较大的作备、较小的作主，恰好让每个主都达到上面的上界；容量都是正数，配满 ⌊n/2⌋ 对不会更差。
将 memory 降序排序，累加第 2、4、6…项（从 0 开始的下标为 1、3、5…）；n 为奇数时最小的那台不用。答案最大约 10^14，需要 64 位整数。
en: Sort the chosen primaries by capacity in descending order: the j-th primary and every primary before it each need a distinct backup at least as large as itself, so the j-th largest primary cannot exceed the 2j-th item of all capacities in descending order.

Sort the capacities in descending order and pair adjacent items, the larger as the backup and the smaller as the primary; this makes every primary reach that bound. Since capacities are positive, filling ⌊n/2⌋ pairs is never worse.

Sort memory in descending order and add the 2nd, 4th, 6th, … items (zero-based indices 1, 3, 5, …); with odd n the smallest server is left unused. The answer can reach about 10^14, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort capacities in descending order and group adjacent items in pairs, making the smaller one the primary; sum items 2, 4, …, and with an odd count leave the smallest item unused.

## Proof of correctness

Order the primaries by capacity in descending order: the j-th primary and every primary before it each need a distinct backup no smaller than itself, so the j-th primary is at most the 2j-th item of the overall descending order. Pairing the largest even number of servers adjacently reaches all of these bounds at once. Capacities are positive, so filling ⌊n/2⌋ pairs is never worse, and this construction is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n); the answer is at most 10^14 and needs 64 bits.
